notes.title: New Upcoming Match 3 Game
notes.content:
I wanted to show you my latest match 3 game which is upcoming in a few months.  Please go and wishlist it to be notified when it get's released!

You can view it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203910/Arabian_Treasures_Midnight_Match

Thanks!

notes.title: Updated to 1.9!
notes.content:
Hello Community,

I overhauled all the in-game translations.  They should now be much more accurate in their respective languages.  In addition, we've added Dutch and Portuguese as well.  We adjusted field lengths and made sure all languages look their best!

We've updated some level data that were causing pain points and fixed some minor bugs throughout.

We hope you enjoy this game and please leave us some feedback and rating.  We appreciate your support!!!

Thanks!

notes.title: Update to 1.5!
notes.content:
Hello Players!!!

I posted a new update (Version 1.5).

This update features:
[list]
    [*]Lots of localization updates.  If anyone's using other languages, this update should be a lot better.
    [*]Minor tweaks to game levels.
    [*]General bug fixes and improvements in a few menus.
    [*]Across the board optimizations and speed improvements.
[/list] 

I hope you all enjoy the game and please don't forget to write a review!  I would appreciate.  If you have any feedback, please post in the forums and I'll be sure to look at and respond.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hello!

I have posted an update to our game!  We mainly fixed minor issues and made some small improvements that we hope you will enjoy after getting some feedback to the game.  We will still continue to work on improvements and bug fixes, but we were able to get to a good stopping point and wanted to safely push out an update for the community.

[b]Update features for Medieval Mystery Match 1.2:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Adjusted some later levels that were causing players to get stuck frequently.
    [*]Fixed store images (hammer showing key and vice-versa).
    [*]Added profile data onto map for quick viewing.
    [*]Fixed hint bug showing you at wrong times, also added option to turn off 
hints.  Increased frequency of hints based on fixes.
    [*]Fixed game over sequence issues.
    [*]Optimized menu responsiveness times.
[/list] 

Regards,
RedZone Studios Team

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
We made it to launch day!! 

First thing, a huge THANK YOU to everyone involved.  We worked hard to make this game fun and enjoyable!  Please post any comments or questions you have in the forums.

We hope you enjoy the game and will continue to support the community long after today :)

- RedZone Studios LLC

notes.title: Medieval Mystery Match Launches in 1 week!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are very excited to announce our game has passed all checks and approvals and is on track for our August 1st release date.  We want to thank everyone who has helped us along the way and we want to ensure everyone that we will continue to support the game, even after release.  This means patches for any obscure bugs we did not catch and adding more content as time goes on.  We hope you enjoy this game as much as we did developing it.

We would love to hear your feedback and suggestions.  Please let us know after playing the game what you think and help us by letting others know about this game too!

- RedZone Studios
